name: vestaloop_sync
description: Pull the key-holder member's linked Google calendar into VestaLoop, reconciling recent changes so that a subsequent vestaloop_list_events reflects the latest. Call this before answering 'what's on the calendar?' when freshness matters (e.g. events may have been added in Google directly). Returns { synced: <count of events reconciled> }. Works with a read or write key. Takes no parameters. No-op if the member hasn't linked a Google calendar.
